title: Policy spec: risk_rules
description: WS-07 (semantics jointly with WS-09). Validates Policy.spec when policyType=risk_rules (C-DEF section 2). Deterministic risk classification (D-19): every rule is a pure predicate over facts computed by the risk.classify activity from the diff bundle, the service catalog (WS-04 ecosystem), CODEOWNERS, and data classification labels. The resulting level is the maximum over fired rules. An LLM may raise the level (never lower it) only within llm_raise bounds. A tenant-scoped risk_rules document is merged with the global one by union of rules (tightening only; ADR-013). Built-in, non-removable rules (evaluated even if a document omits them): ci.executed_paths (critical) and tests.changed (at least medium), R2-001.

never_publish_paths.description: Paths the Publisher refuses to publish regardless of approval (WS-09 agent-capabilities §6 never_publish). The base layer must include .github/workflows/** and .github/actions/**; tenant layers may only add (tightening check).

ci_executed_paths.description: Paths that target-repo CI executes (R2-001). Non-removable: the base layer's list is a floor and tenant layers may only add (ADR-013 tightening check). Any change touching one of them is classified `critical` by the built-in rule `ci.executed_paths` and needs an approval bound to the exact diff on every publish, repair push, and takeover push (github-app.md §10.1).

evidence_template.description: Rendered with matched facts only, e.g. 'changed {path} matches {glob}'. Never interpolates untrusted text.

predicate.description: All present conditions must hold (AND). Use any_of / all_of / not for composition.

paths_all_within.description: true iff every changed path matches one of these globs (used for low-risk docs rules)

deleted_or_skipped_tests.description: QA harness reports tests deleted or newly skipped vs base_sha

outside_plan_paths.description: Changed files the approved plan did not name

secret_scan_finding.description: Secret scanner finding in the diff (publish is blocked separately; this raises the level for the record)

test_files_changed.description: Any changed path matches the codebase binding's test globs; default = WS-09 agent-capabilities.md §6 raise_to_medium list (**/test/**, **/tests/**, **/testdata/**, **/__tests__/**, **/*_test.go, **/test_*.py, **/*_test.py, **/*.test.ts, **/*.test.js, **/*.spec.ts, **/*.spec.js, **/src/test/**; R1V-171)

blast_radius_at_least.description: WS-04 briefing blast_radius.level (XD-04-06); may only raise risk

contract_breaking_with_consumers.description: WS-05 qa_report.contract_compat found a breaking change with known consumers (XD-04-06)

diff_unicode_controls.description: An added line contains a bidi control (U+202A–U+202E, U+2066–U+2069) or a zero-width character (U+200B–U+200D, U+2060, U+FEFF); the same scan that draws the packet's fact chips (approvals.md A-10; R2-007, R1V-175)
